{{Quote|This is Rescue Leader. We've got your signature and are falling into formation behind you, now.| [[Rescue Leader]] to [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] while aboard Rescue 1|<ref name="Starfighter" />}}
'''''Rescue 1''''' was the callsign of a [[Rescue Boat]] that served [[Rescue Flight]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> ''Rescue 1'', with [[Rescue Leader]] commanding from aboard, participated in an [[Raid on the Solleu River|operation]] to free prisoners from a [[Trade Federation prison camp|Federation prison camp]] on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]]. With [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] providing air support, ''Rescue 1'' liberated [[Camp Three (Naboo)/Legends|Camp Three]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

After rendezvousing with [[Rescue 2 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 2'']], and [[Rescue 3 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 3'']], ''Rescue 1'' led the three to the [[Europa Islands]]. There, ''Rescue 1'' transferred its passengers to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]''.<ref name="Starfighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Rescue 1'' appeared in the [[2001]] video game [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']], voiced by [[Carlos Alazraqui]].<ref name="Starfighter" />
